id: title:Gilbert09:drop queued size splits that the merge budget no longer needs

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion optimization: P1.F2.H1 adds a helper to skip unnecessary size-split rewrites when the current merge budget is sufficient, potentially reducing redundant warehouse work and storage; P1.F4.H4 documents this behavior and records skipped repartition events.
review.reason: Adds a helper and tests to skip unnecessary warehouse size-split rewrites when the merge budget is sufficient, and documents this behavior while recording skipped repartition events. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement to warehouse ingestion efficiency and observability.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and production adoption are not demonstrated; this is an implementation and documentation change, not a measurement of avoided incidents or realized performance gains.
